title: Market & Business Case
description: Confirms the program has a validated market rationale and an approved financial case before further concept work proceeds.

title: Technical Feasibility & Cost
description: Confirms the concept is technically achievable within the program's cost envelope and locked requirements.

title: Program Governance
description: Confirms the program is formally chartered, its risks logged, and functional leads have signed off to proceed.

title: Quality & Regulatory Readiness
description: Confirms quality targets and applicable market regulations are understood before the concept is locked.

title: Design Review & Concept Validation
description: Confirms the DR0 design review has closed and the concept is evidenced as meeting customer and business requirements.

title: Quality & Verification Planning
description: Confirms design-level failure modes are analyzed and the verification plan is in place ahead of virtual validation.

title: Styling & Package Freeze
description: Confirms the styling theme, package layout and ergonomics are locked ahead of detail design.

title: Powertrain & Sourcing
description: Confirms the powertrain selection and supplier sourcing strategy are set, with a manufacturability check complete.

title: Cost Planning
description: Confirms the program-level cost target has been decomposed to system/component level.

title: Process & Verification Planning
description: Confirms the manufacturing-process failure analysis and executable verification plan are complete.

title: Structural & Durability Simulation
description: Confirms structural, durability and overall virtual validation results meet target and are CAE signed-off.

title: NVH, Thermal & Emissions
description: Confirms cabin comfort (NVH), thermal management and emissions compliance are validated in simulation.

title: Digital Mockup & Tolerance
description: Confirms clearances, assembly sequence and dimensional tolerance stack-up are validated digitally.

title: Electrical & Software Architecture
description: Confirms the electronic/software architecture is reviewed and the electrical schematic is locked.

title: Drawing Release & Vendor Readiness
description: Confirms production-intent drawings are released and prototype-phase suppliers are onboarded and PPAP-submitted.

title: Prototype Build
description: Confirms validation-prototype parts have been received, assembled, and build quality documented.

title: Manufacturing Readiness
description: Confirms tooling is kicked off, the process sheet is drafted, and the line's manufacturing feasibility is reviewed.

title: Test Planning & Calibration
description: Confirms the physical test campaign is planned and powertrain/chassis calibration results are in.

title: Quality & Cost Verification
description: Confirms component qualification evidence is complete and prototype-phase cost variance is understood.

title: Validation Closure
description: Confirms final validation-prototype testing, durability and reliability results close out all DVP requirements.

title: Homologation & Certification
description: Confirms homologation builds, emissions and safety compliance test results are certified for target markets.

title: Field Trial & Warranty
description: Confirms real-world field trial results are in and pre-launch warranty exposure has been assessed.

title: Production Part Approval
description: Confirms supplier PPAP packages are complete and parts are formally approved for volume production.

title: Line & Process Readiness
description: Confirms production tooling is released and the line's readiness/process capability is demonstrated.

title: Engineering & Line Trial
description: Confirms the design is frozen for volume production and the full-rate line trial has run successfully.

title: Production Batch & Readiness
description: Confirms the pre-production batch build and the final cross-functional launch readiness review are complete.

title: Post-Launch Quality
description: Confirms early-build quality, customer feedback and early warranty claims are reviewed shortly after launch.

title: Continuous Improvement & Cost
description: Optional post-launch planning — ongoing field monitoring, continuous improvement and cost-reduction roadmap.

title: Ramp-up & Retrospective
description: Confirms production ramp-up is tracking to plan and the program retrospective has been captured.
